criteria.criterion: Pure state transitions preserve distinct identity/focus/query/filter/snapshot/expansion/source/preference fields and reject obsolete response sequences even when cancellation loses a race.
Route codecs encode exact IDs and safe view state; bootstrap/session values and source bodies cannot enter copied links, history state or durable preference storage.
Selection emits one navigation event, camera changes emit none, snapshot conflict retains old coherent context, and explicit refresh discards incompatible cursor/expansion state atomically.
Only the shared read client initiates allowed reads; later screens and renderer consume state and emit intentions. Browser-level Back/Forward and focus integration are assigned to TASK-019.
The first screen exposes only reading destinations and no authoring/advanced modules; no giant graph or management counters are initial navigation.
Overview uses validated project purpose/starting IDs; empty local graph explains imported core vocabulary and offers categories/search.
Visible labeled search and submit work without shortcuts; autocomplete follows Arrow/Enter/Escape behavior without deleting query.
Results show supported category, preferred label, recorded excerpt and distinctions; lower-frequency filters remain under one control.
All bound/incomplete/empty cases preserve query and offer useful narrow/clear/continue actions without invented totals.
Definitions/aliases/scope/examples/non-examples remain exact; historical status, source freshness and authority meanings are distinct with warnings by affected information.
Relationship member, qualifier, direction and exact ID are independently inspectable; lengthy qualifiers remain accessible and cannot look unconditional.

Purpose/applicability/roles/inputs/outputs/skills/documents/order each link to exact selected canonical or source support; unsupported fields are omitted.
Absent ordering displays exactly: An ordered description has not been recorded. These are the documented relationships.
Paths/dependencies/layout are never inferred as process execution order; process pages execute nothing, and no additional graph library or authoring is introduced.
The normalized model retains all returned node/relation IDs, canonical endpoints/predicates/direction, qualifiers, sources, warnings, filters and limits without inferring completeness.

Focus here deliberately replaces neighborhood; expansion preserves existing positions where practical, stops bounded layout and respects cumulative 100-node/200-edge proposed ceiling and tighter service limits.
Parallel IDs, self-loops, cycles, conditional qualifiers, direction and selected/adjacent labels remain faithful; no continuous hidden simulation or unsupported semantic position claim.
Renderer reads the normalized model and emits intentions; it never initiates source/ontology reads. Legend and guidance retain: Select a term to read it. Use Focus here to explore its connections.
AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-34 preserve useful context, reject stale responses and mixed snapshots, discard incompatible expansions/cursors on refresh and keep List/evidence usable if renderer fails.
When no relationships are recorded in the returned view, say No relationships are recorded in this view; byte/time/traversal limits and incomplete data are distinguished from absence.
320 CSS-pixel layouts, substantial zoom, both themes and reduced motion preserve controls, reading, narrow drawers and vertically flowing process/source text.
Back/Forward restores useful reading/map context; deliberate node selection pushes one history item while camera movements do not spam history.
Terms/Map switching preserves exact identity; credentials are absent from safe routes and copied links; normal new-tab entry links work after authentication where practical.
Theme light/dark/system and reset affect presentation only; source bodies and knowledge are not persisted to browser databases/storage.
